name: Fairmont Grand Hotel Kyiv
positioning: Fairmont hotel with a wedding cake facade on the Dnipro River in Kyiv's historical Podil area
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base in Podil

facts.text: The hotel is in Podil, described as the historical area of Kyiv, next to an embankment along the Dnipro river.
Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as set behind a nineteenth-century stone facade on the Dnieper River in Podil.
Guest rooms and suites have marble bathrooms.
Fairmont Gold suites are located on the 11th and 12th floors.
The hotel offers experiences at Elixir SPA Deluxe.
Indoor parking is available for an additional fee.

highlights.text: The hotel has a wedding cake facade and sits on the banks of the Dnipro River.
SL Kyiv Casino offers gaming tables including American Roulette and Blackjack, plus slot machines.
Room decor blends contemporary comforts with heritage elements such as elaborate draperies, golden chandeliers, floral bedspreads and jewel-toned carpets.
The hotel hosts a movie night that pairs a cinema club with themed set dinners created by the chef.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes this property is not available for online booking and reservations are made by contacting WhataHotel.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Fairmont Grand Hotel Kyiv
